acceptanceCriteria: Precise interface: overlay is `serde_json::Value` object (not `PrdUserStory`). Validation order is load-bearing: top-level `status`/`passes` (any value, incl. false/null) → lifecycle `invalid_state("update", …)` pointing at `complete`/`fail`/`skip`/`<task-status>` → other unknown keys (name ALL of them) → type/null table → no whitelist field besides `id` (`id`-only is FEAT-004). Id is lookup-only (`newId`/`renameTo` unknown). Both `estimatedEffort` and `difficulty` present → ambiguous hard-error; either present SETs `difficulty` and JSON-patches as `estimatedEffort` (remove leftover `difficulty` key)

Whitelist (JSON camelCase) plus lookup `id`: `title`, `description`, `notes`, `acceptanceCriteria`, `touchesFiles`, `dependsOn`, `estimatedEffort`/`difficulty`, `model`, `escalationNote`, `requiredTests`, `maxRetries`, `requiresHuman`, `humanReviewTimeout`, `claimsSharedInfra`, `reviewScope`, `severity`, `sourceReview`, `humanReviewOutcome`. Nothing else (`priority`, `synergyWith`/`batchWith`/`conflictsWith`, `foo` are unknown)

Type/null table binds overlay keys to `PrdUserStory` field types (src/commands/init/parse.rs) but overlay reject is fail-closed — do not reuse serde defaults: `title` → `title: String` (non-empty string; null/empty/non-string error); nullable `Option<String>` scalars `description`/`notes`/`model`/`escalation_note`/`severity`/`source_review`/`difficulty` (overlay `estimatedEffort`/`difficulty`) → string or `null` clears, wrong type error; `humanReviewTimeout` → `human_review_timeout: Option<u32>` **unsigned integer** or `null` clears (negative/float/string/bool/array/object error — do not lump with string scalars); `claimsSharedInfra` → `claims_shared_infra: Option<bool>` bool or `null` clears (string/number/array/object error, e.g. `"true"`); `reviewScope` → `review_scope: Option<Value>` JSON value or `null` clears (do not `as_str()`); arrays `dependsOn`/`touchesFiles`/`acceptanceCriteria`/`requiredTests` → `Vec<String>` (`[]` clears; `null`/non-array/non-string element error); `requiresHuman` → `requires_human: Option<bool>` but overlay requires JSON bool (`null`/non-bool error — stricter than serde Option); `maxRetries` → `max_retries: Option<i32>` but overlay requires integer (`null` error, column NOT NULL, do not default to 3); `humanReviewOutcome` → `human_review_outcome: Option<Value>` object or `null` (array/string/number/bool error). Nested `passes` inside `humanReviewOutcome` is not a top-level key — allowed

Edge cases: full story blob with `"passes": false` plus valid `notes` takes the lifecycle error (order: status/passes first); `priority` unknown-key (not a 'coming soon' message); synergyWith unknown; `title` empty; `dependsOn: null`; `maxRetries: null`; `requiresHuman: 1`; `claimsSharedInfra: "true"`; `humanReviewTimeout: -1`
Invariants: no writes on any reject; no partial apply; deny_unknown_fields is NOT set on `PrdUserStory` (would break extra keys on import of old PRDs)

Known-bad discriminators: (1) `from_value::<PrdUserStory>(overlay)` — `passes` defaults false (ignored or applied) and extra keys vanish; (2) treating `maxRetries: null` as serde None then defaulting to 3 — column NOT NULL trap; (3) checking nested keys inside `humanReviewOutcome` for `passes`
Failure modes: every reject is `invalid_state("update", …)` before LockGuard/write txn when possible; always before any UPDATE

Alternatives considered: rejected `deny_unknown_fields` on `PrdUserStory` (breaks old PRD extra keys; overlay reject is a different type); rejected 'null always clears' (arrays/`requiresHuman`/`maxRetries`/`title` would corrupt NOT NULL / tables)
Downstream impact: FEAT-003 (implement validator), FEAT-004 (calls it before writes), FEAT-005 (directory preflight still before parse), FEAT-006 (error copy), FEAT-008 (sandbox rejects)
